summary: A minimal Elektron-style groovebox firmware with four tracks, built on the MONOFM sound core (itself a Felucca fork). Its manual is written in Russian.
features: Four tracks, each with its own machine; one sound core shared with MONOFM
Patterns in banks A to E with per-pattern kits and chains
Parameter locks, trig states and grid recording from the keys
Arpeggiator per track with latch; live recording from keys and MIDI
MIDI notes over USB and TRS on channels 1 to 4
Shares a flash area with MONOFM: saving erases the other's project
